info.name: Florin Bank API
info.description: End-to-end walk through the Florin API: sign up, sign in, open accounts, move money, read statements. Run top to bottom (Postman runner or `newman run`). Every request asserts its status and the ones that create things save ids into collection variables for the next request.

exec: pm.test('200 with bank rules', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.currency).to.eql('INR'); pm.expect(body.perTransactionLimit).to.be.above(0); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('email', 'postman-' + Date.now() + '@example.com');

pm.test('201 with the new customer', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.fullName).to.eql('Postman Tester'); pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); });

pm.test('200 with a bearer token', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', body.token); });
pm.test('401 with code INVALID_CREDENTIALS', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('INVALID_CREDENTIALS'); });
pm.test('200 with my email', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('email')); });

item.name: 06 Accounts (one savings account opened at sign-up)

exec: pm.test('200 with the starter savings account', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(list[0].type).to.eql('SAVINGS'); pm.expect(list[0].balance).to.eql(0); pm.collectionVariables.set('accountId', list[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('accountNumber', list[0].accountNumber); });

pm.test('201 with a 12-digit account number', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.accountNumber).to.match(/^[1-9]\d{11}$/); pm.collectionVariables.set('secondAccountId', body.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('secondAccountNumber', body.accountNumber); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('idempotencyKey', 'postman-' + Date.now());

pm.test('201 with a receipt', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.type).to.eql('DEPOSIT'); pm.expect(body.reference).to.match(/^FLR/); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Idempotent-Replayed')).to.eql('false'); });
pm.test('201 marked as a replay', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Idempotent-Replayed')).to.eql('true'); });
pm.test('balance inquiry', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().balance).to.eql(10000); });
pm.test('201 withdrawal', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().type).to.eql('WITHDRAWAL'); });
// 50,000 is under the per-payment limit (checked first) but over the 7,499.50 balance.

pm.test('422 INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS with available balance', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql('INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS'); pm.expect(body.available).to.eql(7499.5); });

pm.test('201 transfer with both legs', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.type).to.eql('TRANSFER'); pm.expect(body.from.own).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.to.own).to.eql(true); pm.collectionVariables.set('reference', body.reference); });
pm.test('200 with the same reference', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().reference).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('reference')); });

pm.test('200 with four ledger lines', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.totalElements).to.eql(4); pm.expect(body.content[0].type).to.eql('TRANSFER'); pm.expect(body.content[0].balanceAfter).to.eql(1200); });
pm.test('200 and the running balance ends at 6,299.50', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().content[0].balanceAfter).to.eql(6299.5); });

pm.test('200 text/csv attachment', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.include('attachment'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('Date,Reference,Description'); });

pm.test('200 masked holder name', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.holderName).to.eql('Postman T.'); pm.expect(body.ownAccount).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('200: only the withdrawal counted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().usedToday).to.eql(2500.5); });

pm.test('200 with 30 history points', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.history).to.have.length(30); pm.expect(body.totalBalance).to.eql(7499.5); });
pm.test('200 with this session marked current', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(s => s.current)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('204', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('401 after logout', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
